source.snippet: STOP making Vibe Slop websites that LAG on my MBP and workstation. I get it, you want to show off how 'cool' you are with your hijacked scrolling and 50 million animations... If it lags, I'm closing the tab. Nobody gives a shit. I'm not impressed... the AI agent [reads your site too]

problem_statement: AI-generated and vibe-coded marketing websites increasingly ship with janky scroll-jacking, excessive animations, and layout bloat that degrades performance on real hardware and drives potential customers away before conversion.
target_segment: Founders and marketing teams at early-stage startups shipping AI-assisted websites; web performance agencies serving them
notes: Growing frustration signal (3 points, comments) on HN around AI-slop websites hurting UX. A B2B performance audit/fix service or a Lighthouse-style automated 'vibe site health checker' could sell to founders who paid to build these sites and now want to fix them. Buyer intent indirect but present — founders paying for web presence are the natural buyers.
